scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/backend/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/vscode-extension/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/webstorm-extension/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/utils/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build: rm -rf packages/types/out packages/utils/out && tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/utils/tsconfig.build.json
